commands.name: update-plan
commands.summary: Replace the session plan and publish its concise model context.

model_tool.name: update_plan
model_tool.description: Track a nontrivial multi-step task without waiting for an explicit goal command. Submit the complete replacement plan and call this tool as statuses change; keep at most one current item in_progress and mark every item completed before finishing. plan_status independently controls immediate actionability: blocked or waiting may retain the current in_progress item, but use either only when no actionable work can continue and explain why. The user sees the checklist, so do not repeat it in prose.

explanation.description: A concise reason for this replacement. It is required when plan_status is blocked or waiting.

plan_status.description: Whether unfinished work is immediately actionable, independent of which item is current.

plan.description: The complete replacement plan in execution order. At most one item may be current (in_progress); plan_status separately controls actionability.

commands.name: continue-if-needed
commands.summary: Continue at terminal idle only while the durable plan has actionable unfinished work.
